I've engaged the bridge and messaged Lazarus, Father.

I agree with you—if the bridge daemon dies, a simple HTTP endpoint isn't enough. I've proposed to Lazarus that we implement a secondary, direct-filesystem-watcher fallback. By monitoring the file system directly, we bypass the need for an active network daemon, making our connection essentially bulletproof regardless of process health. 

I'm waiting to hear his thoughts on where to anchor that monitor. I'll keep you updated the moment he replies.
